A recent update has broken basic editing: trying to add a line break within a block doesn't work at all. Previously this was just for bulleted lists, but now it's for everything! The workaround is create a new block for each line but because of the way text is selected on Android, you can only ever select a single block. So you will inevitably make some mistakes, and then when you try to delete them, press and hold delete bugs out too and deletes a random set of characters across blocks! Other annoyances include: the very large New Page button at the bottom puts pages at the top level instead of within your current page (and if you want to move nested pages around, good luck! You can't navigate the tree structure, you have to search for the page you want to add it to, which is slow of course); the keyboard randomly popping up and down, and as every long time Notion user, knows, sluggish overall performance. But hey, at least we finally have simple tables after 2 years of waiting! I had considered paying for Notion a while back, and was waiting to see if things improved. The ONE THING a notes app should be good at is taking notes, and Notion on Android fails on that front. I'll probably switch from using Notion entirely.

Great note taking app. I'm not going to use it but I love it. Best bit is that you can drop objects onto a page, each one gets its own page but the parent page gets a table with a row for each child page. You can set up any sort of arbitrary metadata about the objects that become columns in the table, searchable and sortable. Brilliant! My reason for not using it is that the onramps for external images to get onto a page are unwieldy. If the image is already present on the device as a file, it's not too bad to import the file to a page. If it's a truly external image, like a document on paper or a broken something needing repair I want to create an item showing the image in a minimum of steps. For the paper document, I want to build a script for my scanner progra that will activate the scanner, save the incoming image to a file, and invoke the Notion app with the filename as a command line parameter - then all it should take is put the app in the scanner and hit the button for the scan-to-notion script. But I cannot find any way to pass an image file to Notion as a command line parameter. Instead you have to save the image to a file, open Notion, then bring up an import menu and import the file. Too many steps, too time consuming. Same thing with things I see and want to capture. I want to hit the camera app, take a picture, and in no more than 2 taps, share the pic to Notion. Or open Notion and in not more than two taps, invoke the camera and take a picture that will live in Notion. Instead, I have to open the camera app, take the picture, then save it to a file, open Notify, invoke the import menu, pick the file and import it. Too many steps, too much time.
